Shader Stamps

Motion·by @raul_dronca·2026-08-20·inspora page·original post

What it is

Shader Stamps: an infinite coverflow of postage stamps on warm beige - each stamp has serrated die-cut edges framing soft aurora shader art (green 'SEASON QUIT', terracotta 'SUDDEN SNEAK', blue 'AIRFLOW', black 'SIGHT COUNTER' 01/2025); the center stamp is large and crisp while neighbors shrink, blur and desaturate toward the edges; the strip glides horizontally (drag or auto-scroll).

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-25%
Green 'SEASON QUIT' stamp centered large; black 'SIGHT COUNTER' mini to its right; small cursor near center.
25-50%
Strip advances: terracotta 'SUDDEN SNEAK' takes center, green recedes left; distant stamps blur to soft rectangles.
50-75%
Blue 'AIRFLOW' stamp centered, its aurora swirling; neighbors fade.
75-100%
Black 'SIGHT COUNTER' centered, dark swirl shader visible; sequence loops seamlessly.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: "Shader Stamps" - an infinite coverflow of postage stamps on warm beige. Each stamp has serrated die-cut edges framing soft aurora shader art (green "SEASON QUIT", terracotta "SUDDEN SNEAK", blue "AIRFLOW", black "SIGHT COUNTER" 01/2025). The center stamp is large and crisp; neighbors shrink, blur, and desaturate toward the edges; the strip glides horizontally.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Warm beige field. Horizontal strip of stamps: center stamp large with its title and aurora art visible; receding stamps progressively smaller, blurred, desaturated. Small cursor near center.

## Motion spec
Pattern: infinite coverflow glide + drag.
- Constant glide ~40px/s, linear, wrap-around (auto-scroll); drag overrides 1:1, release snaps the nearest stamp to center (400ms ease-out).
- Depth falloff: scale 1 -> 0.3, blur 0 -> 12px, opacity/desaturation increasing with distance from center - computed continuously per stamp.
- Each stamp's aurora shader swirls gently (independent slow loop).

## Calibration
- Glide ~40px/s: reading pace. Faster turns the stamps into a blur of color.
- The falloff curve is continuous - no "focused vs blurred" binary; every stamp sits at its own depth.
- Snap 400ms ease-out to the nearest center on release.

## Reduced motion
Strip is static with the center stamp focused; drag still re-centers stamps (positional).

## Don't miss
- The serrated die-cut edge on every stamp (perforated mask) - without it they are just cards.
- Blur AND desaturation together create the depth; blur alone looks like a focus pull.
- Titles sit on the stamps like postmarks ("SIGHT COUNTER" 01/2025) - small, stamped, part of the art.
